newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.777 billion yuan from 2.58 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was less active than Thursday mainly due to the usual slowdown in activity ahead of the weekend.
There were renewed market rumours that the central bank would shortly cut bank reserve ratios, creating market uncertainties and encouraging institutions to cut trading.
Securities houses, which trade on the market through short-term financing centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the most active traders today, traders said.
The rates will move narrowly next week, they said.
